name: cisus
description: Plataforma Angular multiempresa para la comercialización de productos Cisus.

scripts.build: npm run build:angular && npm run build:functions
scripts.test: npm run test:angular && npm run test:functions
scripts.verify: npm run build:angular && npm run test:angular && npm run test:functions && npm run verify:security
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:angular && firebase deploy --only hosting
